task_title: perf:profile - make perf target selection measured, not guessed

plan_review.notes: Adversarial plan review of the perf:profile design. 8 findings, all accepted and folded in: report self AND inclusive time; group frames by name+url+line; surface-scope the gate (sim -> perf:profile, render/load -> Chrome trace); require a multi-seed panel; allow a documented low-risk GC/spike exception but forbid bundling small wins to clear the bar; state self-vs-inclusive scope on Amdahl ceilings; narrow the 3-apple trigger to risk patterns rather than a blanket core-hot-path rule; require escape/alias regression coverage rather than only a reentrancy guard.

rounds.notes: A crashed run was silently accepted as a valid profile; docs advertised a --json <path> form the CLI rejected.
The Run Complete marker check still accepts Outcome: ERROR because runHeadless catches mid-run exceptions and the CLI prints the marker first. Replaced with an Outcome: allowlist.

Clean. Verified HEALTHY_OUTCOMES matches RunStats[outcome] exactly, STALLED is safe to profile, the tsx entrypoint guard cannot silently no-op on Windows, all fail() paths terminate, and importing the CLI in a test does not run main().
